name: ui-layouts-tabs
blurb: Animated tabs with wobbly underline that follows active tab.
description: Context-based animated tab system with TabsProvider, TabsBtn, and TabsContent. Active indicator animates with spring physics, creating a wobbly follow effect. Supports hover previews and directional slide animations.
use_when: Modern UI layouts where playful animations and smooth tab switching enhance the visual experience. Great for portfolio or creative sites.
avoid_when: Accessibility-focused applications; keyboard navigation not supported. Animations may distract from content-heavy interfaces.
a11y: No built-in keyboard support or ARIA attributes. Focus and tab semantics must be managed externally.
